caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sideboard or console table with four tapered legs. The table is rendered in various shades of brown, with the main structure and legs in a deeper reddish-brown hue, while the panels on the front are a lighter, more yellowish-brown, decorated with green and yellow floral motifs. The table features three drawers on its front; the central drawer is wider and gently curved, flanked by two smaller, rectangular drawers. Each drawer has round, gold-colored handles. The legs of the table have a vertical inlay or painted design in a lighter color. There is a printed label to the left of the table stating "Note mouldings around panels." The overall background of the drawing is off-white with some brown smudges and signs of wear.
title: Desk
